notes.title: Duck N Roll has officially Released!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Duck N Roll has officially Released! 🎉

[previewyoutube=h2whCKOwmMI;full][/previewyoutube]

[list]
[*] A new mode [b]World Tour[/b] has been added.
[*] New maps [b]Ocean, Tundra[/b] have been added.
[*] [b]Two new characters[/b] have been added.
[*] [b]New Dice upgrades and trinkets[/b] have been added.
[*] [b]New souvenirs[/b] have been added.
[/list]

Play now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3007390/Duck_N_Roll/

We're excited to have released Duck N Roll, and it's all thanks to your interest and support!

For the latest news or to connect with other players, feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/xHDT4KKv]Duck N Roll Discord server[/url]!

If you're enjoying the game, please consider leaving a positive review. 
It helps a lot with the game's launch—thank you so much!





P.S. Don’t worry! Not a single duck was harmed in the making of this game! 🦆

notes.title: The massive update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/71418f271667c14b679e7f6b51a4de2f7e5ff47a.png[/img]
Hello!
The massive update patch has finally been applied!
We have made various changes to provide a more enjoyable game and a thrilling experience.
Now you can feel the fun of a new game!
We hope you enjoy it again!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/be02d303c5ed03fae69be202a75270f309395e02.gif[/img]

<Changes>
-Hand ranks
  Now, a straight can be made with 4 dice!
  However, it only attacks the designated target twice.
  If the target falls on the first attack, the second attack is cancelled!

-Dice usage method
  Remaining dice in your bag can now be used all in your turn.
  You can now attack twice in a row!

-Dice effects
  Glass dice now deal area damage as they break.
  The clown trinkets receives an effect when rerolled into a chain trinkets.

-Dice face change reward
  Dice faces can no longer be changed, but it will be more fun that way!

-Battle rewards, bonus rewards
 The list of rewards has been expanded.

-Mini-game
  A mini-game has been added where you can choose good rewards if you roll the dice well!

-Souvenir
  Hot sauce souvenir has been removed.

-Leaderboard reset

-Save records deleted

Oh, everyone! Duck N Roll is currently participating in the Busan Indie Connect Festival!
We are constantly striving to bring you fun.
Please also show interest in the BIC event!

notes.title: A new item has been added!
notes.content:
Hello!
A new item has finally been added!
Everyone, the [b][u]Dice's Trinket[/u][/b] is now available.
Dice's Trinkets are a new effect that can be added to dice along with Upgraded Dice.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/7b5d2ae13352a2470cc76cee5ab7a19d2db8e017.png[/img]

[u][b]Try creating various combinations by adding Dice's Trinkets to Upgraded Dice![/b][/u]
Enjoy your adventure with your own unique combinations!
Dice's Trinkets can be continuously swapped!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/71418f271667c14b679e7f6b51a4de2f7e5ff47a.png[/img]
[b]<Changes>[/b]
- Now, when you choose the hand rank upgrade reward, all hand ranks will be upgraded.
- Single-face dice will no longer appear in dice rewards.
- King Dice will no longer appear.
- The difficulty of stages has been adjusted.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/dbe5d9c009a4c1c8d8a458c8c4570b1db8299d55.gif[/img]
[b]Oh no! Because of these changes, previous gameplay records will be deleted. Sorry.
The leaderboard will also be reset![/b]

Have fun and please share your opinions in the community hub!
We always look forward to your feedback.
Thank you!

notes.title: Balance Updates
notes.content:
Hello!
We are rolling out our first Update since the demo release.
This Update focuses on simple balance adjustments, and more fun updates will follow soon.

[u][b]Please note that the leaderboard will be reset after this Update.[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/71418f271667c14b679e7f6b51a4de2f7e5ff47a.png[/img]
[b]<Changes>[/b]
- The level-up values for One Pair and Two Pair have increased from [b]3 to 7[/b].
- The effect of Full House has been modified. Now, only monsters behind the selected target will receive 
   excess damage.
- The number of attack rounds for [b]Five Dice[/b] has been increased by [b]1[/b].
- The variety of dice faces appearing as rewards from changing dice face  has been expanded.
- The conditions for selection events have been eased.
- Previously, there was a 100% chance for already acquired dice upgrade to reappear as rewards, but this 
   is no longer guaranteed.
- The damage of the Hot Sauce has increased from [b]2 to 4[/b].
- The King Dice now only activates during rerolls ([b]not when drawing[/b]).

Please keep rolling!
More exciting updates are on the way soon!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/be02d303c5ed03fae69be202a75270f309395e02.gif[/img]

We will be back with these new changes on [b]July 26th![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45091697/94d23514370cf6bdda26780499a30391004715da.gif[/img]
